facts.text: Spotify Support is the customer support service for Mia's Spotify Premium subscription. She writes to it about billing disputes.

evidence.quote: Hello Spotify Support,

facts.text: Mia changed her plan from Premium Family to Premium Individual on March 30, 2025, and received a confirmation email the same day.

evidence.quote: I changed my plan to Premium Individual on March 30, 2025
I received a confirmation email for it the same day

facts.text: On April 8, 2025, Mia was charged $16.99 for the Family plan instead of $11.99 for Individual, and she asked for the $5.00 difference back.

evidence.quote: I was charged $16.99 for Premium Family on April 8, 2025
I should have been charged $11.99 for Premium Individual

facts.text: Mia argued that the confirmation email said the new plan would start at the next billing date, which was April 8.

evidence.quote: which was April 8

facts.text: Mia cancelled Premium Individual on February 20, 2026, and her account showed that Premium would end on March 7, 2026.

evidence.quote: I cancelled my Premium Individual plan on February 20, 2026
Premium would end on March 7, 2026

facts.text: On March 8, 2026, Mia was still charged $11.99, and Premium showed as active again. She asked Spotify to cancel the subscription, refund the charge and confirm there would be no further charges.

evidence.quote: On March 8, 2026 I was still charged $11.99
confirm that no further charges will be made

facts.text: Mia says she did not restart Premium herself and has not played anything on the account since March 7, 2026. She asked Spotify to check which device restarted the subscription.

evidence.quote: I did not restart Premium on March 8, 2026
check which device restarted the subscription

facts.text: When the first reply turns her down, Mia asks for the refund as a one-time exception and asks for the request to be escalated to the billing team.

evidence.quote: escalate the request to the billing team
as a one-time exception

facts.text: Mia's emails to support are short, polite and specific: she gives exact dates and amounts and states clearly what she wants done.

evidence.quote: Since the plan change was made before the renewal date
please escalate the request to the billing team
